pattern: search by assignee and status filters
experience: A teammate asks which tickets Dana still has open and the agent should query the tracker through the project tool.
rule: t3_work_item_search filters by status, assignee, labels, type, sprint and free text; read-only.
prompt: What is Dana still working on that is not done yet? I need the list before standup.

experience: The user wants a note added to a ticket; the agent proposes it as a draft instead of claiming it was posted.
